history.summary: A large 1,851 sqft freehold 3BR at D'Casita (2011) near Kembangan, asking $2.95M. Freehold and a decent location, but the $2.95M price is well above the liquid band, the unit is oversized for a 3BR, and there is no URA price signal — a niche, expensive investment proposition.
history.rating_rationale: $1,594 psf is moderate for FH D14, but 1,851 sqft drives the price to $2.95M — squarely above the band where the buyer pool thins. An 1,851 sqft 3BR is oversized (own-stay-oriented), and there is no URA series to confirm appreciation. Freehold + Kembangan MRT (650m) provide a floor, but at $2.95M this is a slow, buyer-specific exit rather than a liquid investment.
red_flags: $2.95M is above the liquid band — shallow buyer pool
Oversized 1,851 sqft 3BR skews own-stay; niche resale
No URA transaction data — no appreciation/liquidity read
Boutique-scale development typical of the Kembangan FH belt — limited liquidity
catalysts: Spacious layout appeals to upgrader families if priced right
